biography: Beat, stylized in all caps as BEAT, is an American rock supergroup and touring project formed in 2024. It originally featured former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin alongside guitarist Steve Vai, and drummer Danny Carey. Terry Bozzio filled in for Carey during their Fall 2026 tour. The project was assembled to reinterpret and perform material from King Crimson’s albums Discipline (1981), Beat (1982), and Three of a Perfect Pair (1984), which featured Belew and Levin.
